entries.title: Rawat Ji or Meera Ji: Who's Got the Better Idea?
entries.source_basis: Previously identified ICICI Bank campaign description, not video frames or audio.

proposed_learnings.description: Use two characters with opposing approaches to the same problem.
Start with a recognisable habit rather than a product explanation.
Let the product demonstrate a smarter solution to the problem.
Use character interaction to make a functional banking benefit engaging.
